statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+1) ≠ 0 → (∃ k : ℕ, n = 2^k) ∨ (∃ k : ℕ, n+1 = 2^k)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 零点对与相位 · TP-0023 · 证明相邻 Mangoldt 对中偶数端必为二的幂
plain_statement.en: New route · Zero pairs and phases · TP-0023 · Show the even member of an adjacent Mangoldt pair is a power of two

brief.zh: 由支撑得到两个素数幂，在偶数端识别唯一素因子。
brief.en: Use the support of Mangoldt and determine the unique prime of the even endpoint.
